title: Maya's Week
text:
Maya is fifteen years old and lives in a small town in Poland. Every morning she takes the bus to school with her best friend, Ola. Maya likes art and history, but she does not like early mornings.

After school, Maya goes to an art club on Tuesdays and Thursdays. She often paints pictures of the sea, because she wants to visit it one day. On weekends, she and Ola usually meet at the park to talk and listen to music.

questions.text: How does Maya go to school?
options: She takes the bus with her best friend.
She goes by car with her mother.

questions.text: Why does Maya paint pictures of the sea?
options: She has already visited the sea many times.
She wants to visit the sea one day.
She does not like the sea.
Her art teacher asked her to paint it.

questions.text: What can you infer about Maya and Ola's friendship?
options: They spend a lot of time together.
They do not like the same things.

a group of people who meet for a shared activity

paragraph_translations: Maya ma piętnaście lat i mieszka w małym miasteczku w Polsce. Każdego ranka jedzie autobusem do szkoły ze swoją najlepszą przyjaciółką, Olą. Maya lubi sztukę i historię, ale nie lubi wczesnych poranków.

Po szkole Maya chodzi we wtorki i czwartki na zajęcia plastyczne. Często maluje obrazy morza, ponieważ chce kiedyś je zobaczyć. W weekendy ona i Ola zwykle spotykają się w parku, rozmawiają i słuchają muzyki.
